answer: Prayers & Duties >> Salah (Prayer) Question ID: 33049 Country: United States of America Title: Because of my sickmess some time I went to sleep early and wake up 2 or 3 o'clock in the morning.I pray Namaze-Isha and Tahajjud togeather. Question: Because of my sickmess some time I went to sleep early and wake up 2 or 3 o'clock in the morning.I pray Namaze-Isha and Tahajjud togeather. Is this O.K. Answer ID: 33049 Posted on: Aug 31, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1168/1168/M=1432) Ma-sha-Allah, the habit of offering tahajjud is a blessing. However, the time of Isha remains up to dawn but it is not good to offer salah too late. You should try to offer the fardh of Isha and sunnah before going to bed and offer witr salah with tahajjud. May Almighty Allah give you good health! Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
